import ast
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time
import uuid
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

sys.path.insert(0, '/home/r/dev/minor/stackd/scripts/aws')
from aws_cli import run, result

root=Path('/home/r/dev/minor/stackd')
name='sd-query-alarm-'+uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
namespace='Stackd/QueryAlarm/'+name
path=root/'testdata/aws/cloudwatch/metric_discovery_alarms.json'
env=dict(os.environ,AWS_DEFAULT_REGION='us-west-2',AWS_REGION='us-west-2',AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS='1',AWS_PAGER='',AWS_IGNORE_CONFIGURED_ENDPOINT_URLS='true')
for key in list(env):
    if key.startswith('AWS_ENDPOINT_URL'):
        del env[key]
capture={'caller_account':'000000000000','actor_arn':'','region':'us-west-2','sources':[{'url':'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/cloudwatch-metrics-insights-alarms.html'},{'url':'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/using-search-expressions.html'},{'path':__file__,'content':Path(__file__).read_text()}],'observations':[],'cleanup':[],'owned_alarm':name,'metric_namespace':namespace,'published_metric_samples':0}

def save():
    path.write_text(json.dumps(capture,indent=2)+'\n')

def call(label,operation,parameters,service='cloudwatch',cleanup=False):
    started=time.time_ns()//1000000
    process=run(service,operation,parameters,env,options=['--debug','--no-paginate'],timeout=40)
    decoded=result(process,debug=True)
    headers={}
    for line in process.stderr.splitlines():
        if 'Response headers: ' in line:
            headers=ast.literal_eval(line.split('Response headers: ',1)[1])
        if service=='cloudwatch' and line.startswith(("b'",'b"')):
            body=ast.literal_eval(line)
            if body.startswith(b'{'):
                raw=json.loads(body)
                decoded['raw_response']=raw
                if process.returncode:
                    decoded['message']=raw.get('message',decoded.get('message'))
            elif process.returncode and body.startswith(b'<'):
                tree=ET.fromstring(body)
                decoded['message']=next((v.text for v in tree.iter() if v.tag.rsplit('}',1)[-1]=='Message'),decoded.get('message'))
    decoded['request_id']=next((v for k,v in headers.items() if k.lower() in ('x-amzn-requestid','x-amzn-request-id','x-amz-request-id')),'')
    if service=='sts':
        assert decoded['code']=='Success' and decoded['output']['Account']==capture['caller_account'],decoded
        capture['actor_arn']=decoded['output']['Arn']
    capture['cleanup' if cleanup else 'observations'].append({'label':label,'service':service,'operation':operation,'input':parameters,'region':'us-west-2','caller_account':capture['caller_account'],'actor_arn':capture['actor_arn'],'request_started_ms':started,'result':decoded})
    save()
    return decoded

metric={'Id':'m','MetricStat':{'Metric':{'Namespace':namespace,'MetricName':'Load'},'Period':60,'Stat':'Sum'},'ReturnData':True}
search='SEARCH(\'Namespace="'+namespace+'"\', \'Sum\', 60)'
sql='SELECT SUM(Load) FROM "'+namespace+'"'
def expression(text,**fields):
    return dict(Id='q',Expression=text,Period=60,ReturnData=True,**fields)
cases=[
    ('metric-control',[metric]),
    ('search-array',[expression(search)]),
    ('search-reduced',[expression('SUM('+search+')')]),
    ('search-unused',[dict(expression(search),ReturnData=False),metric]),
    ('insights-scalar',[expression(sql)]),
    ('insights-grouped',[expression(sql+' GROUP BY Team')]),
    ('insights-math',[dict(expression(sql),ReturnData=False),{'Id':'e','Expression':'q/2','Period':60,'ReturnData':True}]),
    ('insights-period-ten',[dict(expression(sql),Period=10)]),
    ('insights-period-five-minutes',[dict(expression(sql),Period=300)]),
    ('insights-without-period',[{'Id':'q','Expression':sql,'ReturnData':True}]),
    ('two-insights',[dict(expression(sql),ReturnData=False),{'Id':'other','Expression':sql,'Period':60,'ReturnData':True}]),
    ('insights-with-direct',[dict(expression(sql),ReturnData=False),metric]),
]
call('identity','get-caller-identity',{},'sts')
try:
    for label,queries in cases:
        call(label,'put-metric-alarm',{'AlarmName':name,'ComparisonOperator':'GreaterThanThreshold','EvaluationPeriods':1,'DatapointsToAlarm':1,'Threshold':10,'ActionsEnabled':False,'TreatMissingData':'notBreaching','Metrics':queries})
        call(label+'-retained','describe-alarms',{'AlarmNames':[name]})
finally:
    call('delete-owned','delete-alarms',{'AlarmNames':[name]},cleanup=True)
    absent=call('verify-owned-absent','describe-alarms',{'AlarmNames':[name]},cleanup=True)
    capture['cleanup_verification']={'alarm_absent':absent['code']=='Success' and not absent['output'].get('MetricAlarms') and not absent['output'].get('CompositeAlarms'),'published_metric_samples':0}
    save()
print(json.dumps({'fixture':str(path),'observations':len(capture['observations']),'cleanup':capture['cleanup_verification']}))

import ast
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time
import uuid
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

sys.path.insert(0, '/home/r/dev/minor/stackd/scripts/aws')
from aws_cli import run, result

root=Path('/home/r/dev/minor/stackd')
name='sd-query-alarm-'+uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
namespace='Stackd/QueryAlarm/'+name
path=root/'testdata/aws/cloudwatch/metric_discovery_alarms.json'
env=dict(os.environ,AWS_DEFAULT_REGION='us-west-2',AWS_REGION='us-west-2',AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS='1',AWS_PAGER='',AWS_IGNORE_CONFIGURED_ENDPOINT_URLS='true')
for key in list(env):
    if key.startswith('AWS_ENDPOINT_URL'):
        del env[key]
capture=json.loads(path.read_text())
capture['sources'].append({'path':__file__,'content':Path(__file__).read_text()})
capture.setdefault('owned_alarms',[capture['owned_alarm']]).append(name)

def save():
    path.write_text(json.dumps(capture,indent=2)+'\n')

def call(label,operation,parameters,service='cloudwatch',cleanup=False):
    started=time.time_ns()//1000000
    process=run(service,operation,parameters,env,options=['--debug','--no-paginate'],timeout=40)
    decoded=result(process,debug=True)
    headers={}
    for line in process.stderr.splitlines():
        if 'Response headers: ' in line:
            headers=ast.literal_eval(line.split('Response headers: ',1)[1])
        if service=='cloudwatch' and line.startswith(("b'",'b"')):
            body=ast.literal_eval(line)
            if body.startswith(b'{'):
                raw=json.loads(body)
                decoded['raw_response']=raw
                if process.returncode:
                    decoded['message']=raw.get('message',decoded.get('message'))
            elif process.returncode and body.startswith(b'<'):
                tree=ET.fromstring(body)
                decoded['message']=next((v.text for v in tree.iter() if v.tag.rsplit('}',1)[-1]=='Message'),decoded.get('message'))
    decoded['request_id']=next((v for k,v in headers.items() if k.lower() in ('x-amzn-requestid','x-amzn-request-id','x-amz-request-id')),'')
    if service=='sts':
        assert decoded['code']=='Success' and decoded['output']['Account']==capture['caller_account'],decoded
        capture['actor_arn']=decoded['output']['Arn']
    capture['cleanup' if cleanup else 'observations'].append({'label':label,'service':service,'operation':operation,'input':parameters,'region':'us-west-2','caller_account':capture['caller_account'],'actor_arn':capture['actor_arn'],'request_started_ms':started,'result':decoded})
    save()
    return decoded

metric={'Id':'m','MetricStat':{'Metric':{'Namespace':namespace,'MetricName':'Load'},'Period':60,'Stat':'Sum'},'ReturnData':True}
search='SEARCH(\'Namespace="'+namespace+'"\', \'Sum\', 60)'
sql='SELECT SUM(Load) FROM "'+namespace+'"'
def expression(text,**fields):
    return dict(Id='q',Expression=text,Period=60,ReturnData=True,**fields)
cases=[
    ('ordered-group-insights',[expression(sql+' GROUP BY Team ORDER BY MAX() DESC')]),
    ('ordered-group-insights-limit',[expression(sql+' GROUP BY Team ORDER BY MAX() DESC LIMIT 2')]),
    ('group-insights-reduced',[dict(expression(sql+' GROUP BY Team'),ReturnData=False),{'Id':'e','Expression':'SUM(q)','Period':60,'ReturnData':True}]),
    ('ordered-group-insights-reduced',[dict(expression(sql+' GROUP BY Team ORDER BY MAX() DESC'),ReturnData=False),{'Id':'e','Expression':'SUM(q)','Period':60,'ReturnData':True}]),
]
call('identity','get-caller-identity',{},'sts')
try:
    for label,queries in cases:
        call(label,'put-metric-alarm',{'AlarmName':name,'ComparisonOperator':'GreaterThanThreshold','EvaluationPeriods':1,'DatapointsToAlarm':1,'Threshold':10,'ActionsEnabled':False,'TreatMissingData':'notBreaching','Metrics':queries})
        call(label+'-retained','describe-alarms',{'AlarmNames':[name]})
finally:
    call('delete-owned','delete-alarms',{'AlarmNames':[name]},cleanup=True)
    absent=call('verify-owned-absent','describe-alarms',{'AlarmNames':[name]},cleanup=True)
    verified=absent['code']=='Success' and not absent['output'].get('MetricAlarms') and not absent['output'].get('CompositeAlarms')
    capture['cleanup_verification'].setdefault('alarms',{capture['owned_alarm']:capture['cleanup_verification']['alarm_absent']})[name]=verified
    capture['cleanup_verification']['alarm_absent']=all(capture['cleanup_verification']['alarms'].values())
    save()
print(json.dumps({'fixture':str(path),'observations':len(capture['observations']),'cleanup':capture['cleanup_verification']}))
